description: This PHP test class, ModuleServiceTest, contains unit tests for the ModuleService class within the OrangeHRM project. It verifies methods related to obtaining and updating modules, mocking dependencies like ModuleDao, and uses test data fixtures.

classes.name: ModuleServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the ModuleService class, testing module retrieval and update functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ModuleService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetModuleDao
methods.description: Tests that getModuleDao returns an instance of ModuleDao.

methods.name: testGetModuleList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of module list, mocking ModuleDao to return expected data.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatus
methods.description: Tests updating module status and ensures the service returns the expected module list.
